test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form.

"This error could have been avoided by careful planning."

options.text: This error could be avoided by careful planning.
Someone could have avoided this error.
This error could not have been made.
Careful planning could have avoided this error.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the object in the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "This error could have been avoided by careful planning."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "careful planning" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "could have been avoided" to "could have avoided" (active voice).
 
• Ensure clarity by maintaining the meaning of the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Careful planning could have avoided this error."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"This error could be avoided by careful planning." – This is incorrect as it is not in the correct active voice form.
 
• **Option 2: **"Someone could have avoided this error." – This is valid but does not emphasize careful planning.
 
• **Option 3: **"This error could not have been made." – Incorrect meaning and structure.
